:If you find something like this the easiest way to note it is with a <nowiki>{{Verify}} or {{Fact}}</nowiki> tag just after the part you have questions about (Verify being the nice one ("I think your right, but I would like a source"), Fact being the "I think your wrong" one).  As for an actual reference I would check [[The World of Robert Jordan's The Wheel of Time]], but I can find atleast 3 other references to this on the web (Wikipedia and [http://www.redbrick.dcu.ie/~melmoth/gc18.html Redbrick] for the two that look not to have been copied from each other).  Also when signing your posts  you don't need your name, <nowiki>~~~~</nowiki> automaticaly includes your name, a link to your page and the time/date of the post. --[[User:Melriken|Melriken]] 22:23, 7 February 2008 (UTC)
